Name: Prismatic Fire
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, you can change the color of various fire objects in the game by dropping the following items onto a fireplace, torch, or campfire:

[list]
[*][b]Prismatic Shard[/b] - Prismatic fire
[*][b]Amethyst[/b] - Purple fire
[*][b]Emerald[/b] - Green fire
[*][b]Ruby[/b] - Red fire
[*][b]Topaz[/b] - Yellow fire[b][/b]
[*][b]Diamond[/b] - Pale turquoise fire
[/list]

[youtube]X1sLWXvea0E[/youtube]

You can change the fire color for each gemstone in the config. For prismatic fire, you can change the speed at which the color changes.


[size=5][b]Custom Item Colors[/b][/size]

You can create a color value or shifting color effect for any item using Content Patcher. Here is an example:

[code]﻿
{
    "Format": "1.23.0",
    "Changes": [
        {
            "Action": "EditData",
            "Target": "aedenthorn.PrismaticFire/dictionary",
            "Entries": {
                "Star Shards": {
                    "startColor": {
                        "R": 221,
                        "G": 0,
                        "B": 209,
                        "A": 255
                    },
                    "endColor": {
                        "R": 255,
                        "G": 107,
                        "B": 154,
                        "A": 255
                    },
                    "speed": 1
                }
            }
        }
    ]
}
[/code]

If speed is omitted, the mod will use only the single startColor and will not create a shift effect.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
